blurb: SilverHorn Golf Club offers a par 72 golf course with tree-line fairways, sand and water hazards, and contoured greens. The course features a challenging signature par-4 15th hole with creeks and bunkers. The club hosts golf tournaments, outings, and weekly Buck Night events with food and prizes.
extraNote: Buck Night runs through the end of September on Wednesdays at 5:30 pm
